description: React component for managing team reviewers in the Mattermost admin console, including team search, pagination, toggling enable/disable, and reviewer selection.

classes.name: TeamReviewers
classes.description: React functional component for displaying and managing team reviewers, with search, pagination, toggle, and reviewer selection features.

methods.name: setPaginationValues
methods.description: Calculates and sets the start and end count for pagination display based on current page and total items.

methods.name: fetchTeams
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch teams based on search term and update state accordingly.

methods.name: getHandleToggle
methods.description: Returns a callback to toggle the enabled state of a team reviewer setting.

methods.name: getHandleReviewersChange
methods.description: Returns a callback to update reviewer IDs for a specific team.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page of team results if available.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page of team results if not on the first page.

methods.name: setSearchTerm
methods.description: Sets the team search term and resets pagination to the first page.

methods.name: handleDisableForAllTeams
methods.description: Disables reviewer settings for all listed teams.
